answer: Each new miner should lock a refundable identity bond in a shared grove vault, set to at least three times one epoch's expected emission. The stake returns only after several graded rounds of distinctive work; copied or burst-created accounts are slashed. When a tide of near-duplicate answers arrives, those bonds are burned instead of paid. A comet-like flood of sockpuppets then costs the attacker a large multiple of any reward they might harvest, because every extra identity burns another full bond that honest miners recover only through sustained original contributions.
